purpose: Test whether runtime-visible direct-call structure supports a conservative reward-memory decision between STOP_DIRECT and SUPPLY_STRIPPED_REGISTRY on the already-exposed Audio2Tool signed-return surface.

population.eligible: the already-exposed 217 samples whose original A0 output selected the correct tool: 120 A0 exact-match failures plus 97 A0 exact matches
population.selection_warning: eligibility was defined with scorer-side gold and is not a runtime state or a representative-population claim
population.group_id: receipt query_idx, with every rendition of one query assigned to one fold

actions.STOP_DIRECT: return the original A0 direct response with no second core contact
actions.SUPPLY_STRIPPED_REGISTRY: make one second core contact with the A0-selected tool row or rows rendered by render_b1_tool_schemas with argument_defaults removed

logged_rewards.primary: official exact_match recomputed with the frozen Audio2Tool scorer primitives

runtime_state.source: original A0 response plus the frozen deployment registry
coarse_signature: parse class: invalid, empty, single, or multiple
registry resolution: no-call, all-known, some-unknown, or all-unknown
declared-key relation: no-call, unresolved, exact, subset, superset, or mixed
detailed_signature_additions: declared schema arity bucket: zero, one, two, three-plus, mixed, or unresolved
provided argument-key count bucket: zero, one, two, three-plus, or mixed
forbidden: reference transcript or spoken query text
sample id, query_idx, rendition id, or tier as a feature
tool name, domain, category, or description as a feature

memory_policy.decision: choose SUPPLY_STRIPPED_REGISTRY only when the other-fold memory cell has at least 5 samples, at least 2 observed saves, and zero observed harms; otherwise choose STOP_DIRECT
memory_policy.candidate_selection: among candidates that pass every gate, maximize cross-fitted exact-match net gain, then saves, then minimize second contacts, then choose the lexical candidate id

crossfit.evaluation: each group is acted on only by memory built from the other four folds

failure: write a negative artifact and verdict; make no model contact and open no new Audio2Tool population
success: freeze one controller specification for a separately preregistered prospective discovery run of approximately 100 samples; do not revise the baseline or claim superiority from this screen
